highlights: Earn up to 1% cashback on eligible retail spend when you meet a minimum monthly spend of S$1,000, otherwise earn 0.5% cashback. Cashback is capped at S$100 per month and excludes Grab, Gojek, and taxi transactions.
pros: Purchases are automatically split into monthly installments to ease your cashflow.
pros: Earn 1% cash rebates when your monthly bill is S$1,000 or more.
cons: Not applicable to any cash advance, balance transfer, instalment payment plan, interest fees and other promotions and transactions.

extra.description: The OCBC NXT Credit Card offers a great option for big purchases, with interest-free auto instalments that are split across 3 or 6 months, plus a sweet 1% cash rebate with min. spend of S$1,000.
